run_eval_model_basic: run eval_model with a task and model to get valid and test accuracy metrics
run_eval_model_all_metrics: run eval_model with metrics set to all to compute rouge and accuracy scores
run_eval_model_select_metrics: run eval_model with a comma-separated metrics string to select specific metrics like accuracy and rouge
run_eval_model_multitask_macro: run eval_model across multiple tasks with aggregate_micro false to get macro-averaged metrics
run_get_task_world_logs: use get_task_world_logs to extract per-task logs from a combined multitask world_logs file
